correctness.rationale: Derivation normal form and edge equation follow from invertibility of square vectors; nonzero connected solutions force balanced h-cyclic colorings. Each colored invertible tuple is a cycle of invertible GL_m blocks, and connected decomposition is an h-colored labeled species identity. The h-fold rotation is free because every color appears. Ordinary connected-component reweighting then proves the universal formal generating series and exact dimension range. Direct enumeration for q=2,3,5,7, extension-field GF9 enumeration, and exact rational series checks passed; computations corroborate but do not replace the proof.

originality.rationale: Full Elduque–Labra primary text proves the fixed-graph derivation criterion, but not the closed finite-field distribution over all invertible labeled structure matrices. The new enumerator is obtained by counting connected balanced cyclic-block tuples and inserting their exponential generating function into the all-matrix connected-component decomposition. Bekbaev treats generic geometric triviality; Wei–Zou counts isomorphism classes; a 2026 survey reviews individual derivations and other finite-field averages. No inspected source identifies the full displayed bivariate formal series, though an independently known cyclic-block enumeration could imply it.

value.rationale: A complete natural invariant distribution for all finite fields and dimensions, with sharp characteristic-dependent minimal nonzero dimension and exact first-window masses. Unlike ordinary graph connectivity/centroid counts, the cyclic balancing of nontrivial derivation components makes the invariant field-arithmetic-sensitive. The result materially converts a pointwise derivation classification into an exact all-matrix enumeration.
